title: Mission manifest
$comment: Minimal stub — council-signed-off Phase 0 fields only. Missions add NO control-flow primitives (no loops, conditionals, or async). Extended after the Phase 1 PoC confirms what is actually needed. Keep in sync with docs/contracts/no-runtime-boundary.md.

mission.description: Unique mission id (kebab-case slug). Must match the directory name under src/missions/.

inputs.description: Named parameters the mission accepts (e.g. {target_version: {type: string}}). Keys are kebab-case identifiers; values describe the expected input.

type.description: Scalar type of the input value.

description.description: Human-readable label shown to the user at mission invocation.

default.description: Default value when the input is omitted.

required.description: Whether this input must be supplied by the caller.

phases.description: Ordered sequence of /work directive names this mission executes. Each name must be one of the recognised /work directives.

items.description: A /work directive name. The mission executes these in order via the existing gated /work engine.

catalog.description: Relative path (from the mission root) to a YAML file listing breaking changes for this mission (e.g. catalogs/laravel-10-11.yml). Optional — missions without a catalog are framework-agnostic.

verification.description: Quality gate the mission must pass before the user is asked to review. Optional — defaults to the /work engine's built-in verify directive.

command.description: Shell command to run for verification (e.g. 'php artisan test'). Single-shot; output is returned to the agent for interpretation.

success_pattern.description: Regex the command stdout must match for the gate to pass.

required.description: If true, a failing gate halts the mission and surfaces the failure to the user.

size_tier.description: Estimated scope of the mission. Surfaced to the user at invocation so they can set expectations. Does not affect execution — missions do not auto-select /work budget based on this value.
